implementation_policies: Source resolves worksheet ranges, scoped/global defined-name aliases and tables excluding totals. Existing header identity/count must match; grouped/calculated/external/uninterpreted sources are refused.

Source formula caches require caller verification. Headless stages recalculation; any skips leave formulas unverified. Literal-only sources may still refresh. On refusal the entire checkpoint is restored before returning.
Existing shared indices and unused items remain stable; new typed values append. Records, flags, relationships/content types and all reports sharing the cache are planned and committed together.

Eleven standard aggregate kinds, rows/columns/default subtotals/grand totals, hidden member and selected page filters, manual/label order, multiple measures and compact hierarchy are rebuilt within the supported subset.

Date classification uses source styles and typed old-cache fallback; equivalent ISO dates retain item identity, both epochs and fractional values work, and the fictional 1900 leap day stays numeric rather than invalid XSD date.
Existing cell styles are retained, number/date formats and compact indent are generated. Full pivot style/theme/banding reapplication, autofit and PivotChart synchronization are not implemented.
Collision and resource checks precede mutation, including shared siblings/source/table/merge/array/occupied cells. Old large sparse footprints clear stored cells only.

Owned namespace paths preserve qualified prefixes and foreign/opaque metadata. Unknown content in replaced entries is refused. Generated output is reread for new catalog issues; this is not schema or Office oracle validation.

One shared model operation backs native/browser refresh menus, saving and Undo/Redo. Source edits do not refresh implicitly. Ordinary chart cache updates do not imply PivotChart connection synchronization.
